# Support

Need help with a [@neuron7xLab](https://github.com/neuron7xLab) project?

- **Questions / usage** — open a **Discussion** in the relevant repository (or an
  issue if Discussions are disabled), tagged as a question.
- **Bugs** — open an **Issue** using the bug report template.
- **Feature ideas** — open an **Issue** using the feature request template.
- **Security** — do **not** open a public issue; follow
  [`SECURITY.md`](./SECURITY.md).

Please search existing issues and discussions before opening a new one — your
question may already be answered.
